rationale: C15 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters open by praising the official's leadership of a department, use nearly identical language to accept a resignation effective January 20, 1961 while paying tribute to the official and staff, highlight selected departmental achievements with reference to the official's report, and close by thanking the official and wishing health and happiness upon leaving government service. C01 and C06 share much of this resignation-letter architecture, but C15 has the closest combination of wording and paragraph sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under your direction, the Department of Justice has been noted for its impartial and effective administration of Federal law.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Under your leadership, the Department of Commerce has continued to be an articulate and effective voice for the American free enterprise system.
shared_material.explanation: Both begin with a parallel assessment of departmental performance under the resigning official's direction.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In accepting your resignation as Attorney General, effective January 20, 1961, I take the opportunity to emphasize the outstanding record you have achieved with the assistance of your competent staff.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In accepting your resignation as Secretary of Commerce, effective January 20, 1961, I take the opportunity to pay tribute to you and your excellent staff.
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive shared sentence construction, including the same effective date, acceptance formula, 'take the opportunity' transition, and praise of the official and staff.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am particularly gratified by the establishment and functioning of the new Civil Rights Division. Then too, the outstanding record of the Department in bringing anti-trust actions... is most impressive.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Among the many significant accomplishments of your Department these past eight years, two deserve special mention--the Interstate and Defense Highway Program and the Export Expansion Program.
shared_material.explanation: Both next identify a short set of departmental accomplishments for special emphasis.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Indeed, as your report so well relates, every section of your Department has made commendable advances.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As you point out in your report, the new 41,000 mile highway system has already opened vast new territory for recreation, homes and industry.
shared_material.explanation: Both expressly use the departing official's report as the basis for describing achievements.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For guiding these achievements, as well as many more that come to mind, you have my thanks and deep appreciation. May the future hold good health and happiness. You leave government service with my respect and sincere friendship.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For these activities, as well as the broad range of other functions you have supervised, you have my appreciation and thanks. As you leave government service, I wish you health and happiness in the years to come.
shared_material.explanation: The closings closely match in language and sequence: thanks for enumerated and additional achievements, departure from government service, and wishes for health and happiness.
